11.description: Saskatoon will amend its Zoning Bylaw to increase front door sill height and adjust sidewall area calculations for primary dwellings, offering more flexibility for infill development in established neighborhoods.

chips.text: Councillor Jeffries called the sidewall rule "overly restrictive, overly complex."
Saskatoon and Region Home Builders Association provided input on amendments.
Administration defended retaining the sidewall rule despite consultant options for removal.
Unclear if sidewall rule compromises federal building catalog designs for 4-unit dwellings.
Home Builders Association felt changes may not go far enough for smaller lots.
Administration committed to clearer language in the final bylaw draft.

9.description: Saskatoon approved multiple rezonings in areas like Aspen Ridge and Victoria Avenue, plus bylaw changes for secondary suites and corner lot development.

chips.text: Rezoning for 1401 11th St W was not approved.
